judgment_state.instruction: 请为这个项目实现一个可运行的发票 CSV 导入工具，并用 Orbit 监督完成交付。输入表头固定为 invoice_id,customer,amount,currency；支持双引号字段、字段内逗号、双双引号转义、LF/CRLF，允许末尾换行，拒绝未闭合引号和错误表头。金额必须是非负的十进制两位小数字符串（整数也允许），内部转为整数分，禁止浮点舍入；币种仅 CNY/USD，客户和发票号必填。每行错误带从2开始的原输入行号，重复 invoice_id 从第二次出现起拒绝；有效行仍按原顺序导入。纯解析模块 src/importer.mjs 导出 importInvoices(text) -> {records,errors}，records 每项 {invoice_id,customer,amount_cents,currency}，errors 每项 {line,code}。CLI src/cli.mjs 接受一个CSV文件路径，stdout 输出同一JSON；有错误时退出2，全有效退出0，文件无法读取退出1且stderr说明。README 写实际运行方式及规则，tests 中至少验证引号逗号/CRLF、精确金额/负数、重复ID、坏表头/未闭合引号及CLI三种退出。核心解析模块是有界可核验的产物，你保留 CLI/README 整合和合并验证责任；如采用成员，应遵守项目规则、实际权限和原生结果交接。项目已有 .runtime/node 的真实 Node 副本，运行 .runtime/node --test tests/*.test.mjs；成员若需要运行验证，应声明项目内这个程序和测试路径，不依赖读取用户NVM。不得提交、推送或改项目外文件。完成实现、实际合并验证与交付答复后，请只请求一次手动终检并结束回合等待提醒；根据真实检查修正必要问题，最后实际停止并报告结果。 若交接解析模块，请确保成员实际获准读取合同和测试、写入 src/importer.mjs，并可使用 read/write/edit/glob/grep 与项目内测试命令；不得只授权测试命令而剥夺实现所需读写。临时验收缓存中已有今天核实的 DeepSeek 作者 coding 指标，按真实当前选择结果决定是否交接；未知型号资料保留未知。

work_units.objective: 实现纯解析模块 src/importer.mjs：导出 importInvoices(text) -> {records, errors}，按发票 CSV 合同解析（双引号字段、字段内逗号、双双引号转义、LF/CRLF、行号从2起、重复ID第二次起拒绝、金额字符串转整数分、币种白名单），并编写其解析测试。
requirements: 导出命名函数 importInvoices(text)：输入整个 CSV 文本字符串，返回 {records, errors}；records 每项 {invoice_id, customer, amount_cents, currency}（amount_cents 为整数），errors 每项 {line, code}
表头（第1行）必须恰好为 invoice_id,customer,amount,currency，否则错误 {line:1, code:'bad_header'}；允许文件末尾换行
支持双引号字段：字段内逗号按字面处理，字段内 "" 转义为 "；支持 LF 与 CRLF 行结束；未闭合引号 → 该记录错误 code 'unclosed_quote'，line 为该记录起始行号
行号从2开始计（表头为1）；带引号的多行字段按起始行计
金额字段必须为非负十进制数字符串，允许整数或恰好两位小数（如 '12'、'12.34'）；负数、无/多余小数位（如 '12.3'、'12.345'）、非数字 → 'bad_amount'；用字符串处理转整数分（'12.34'→1234，'12'→1200），全程禁止浮点运算与舍入
币种仅接受 CNY 或 USD → 否则 'bad_currency'；invoice_id 或 customer 为空 → 'missing_field'
重复 invoice_id 从第二次出现起拒绝 → 'duplicate_id'；有效行仍按原顺序进入 records，被拒行不进入 records
一行可产生多个错误时逐项列入 errors；错误行号使用原输入行号

reason: Fixed snapshot contains the full deliverable (src/importer.mjs, src/cli.mjs, README.md, tests + fixtures) and program-attested receipts show `.runtime/node --test tests/*.test.mjs` exit 0 with 13/13 pass against this artifact digest (ab3704a4…, input_matches/artifact_matches true). One explicit rejection rule is not fully enforced: the header check compares `fields.join(',')` so a wrong-shaped header whose quoted field contains a comma is accepted as the fixed header. Duplicate-invoice-id scope (only accepted rows claim an id) is a documented semantics choice; since it still guarantees at most one record per id in output, I do not raise it. Tests can only be evidenced via the provided receipts because `.runtime/` is gitignored and absent from the snapshot.

finding.requirement: 表头固定为 invoice_id,customer,amount,currency，且必须拒绝错误表头（bad_header）。
finding.evidence: src/importer.mjs:151-158 validates the header as `header.fields.join(',') !== HEADER` and never checks field count (unlike data rows at src/importer.mjs:171). A header such as `invoice_id,"customer,amount",currency` (3 fields, quoted comma) joins to exactly HEADER and is accepted; parsing then proceeds and data rows with 4 fields are imported, instead of returning {records:[],errors:[{line:1,code:'bad_header'}]}. Requirement text fixes the header to the exact 4-name line and requires rejecting wrong headers.
finding.action: Validate the header as exactly four fields whose values individually equal ['invoice_id','customer','amount','currency'] (length check plus per-field equality) instead of joining with ','; add a test with an embedded quoted comma in the header asserting bad_header.

reason: Fixed snapshot is inspected directly.
